title: Men in black seen by trick-or-treaters

tellings.quote:
these two weird guys showed up in these
1920s outfits and they said, you know,
if you see something weird, they said
just close your eyes and tell it to
land."

plain: A man named Charles recalls an odd moment from the mid 1980s in southeast New York, when children were out trick-or-treating. He says two strange men showed up dressed in 1920s clothes and told them that if they ever saw something weird, they should close their eyes and tell it to land. In UFO lore such odd strangers are called men in black, and the story is told as a hint that someone knew more about strange sightings than they let on.
